title: AER Execution Receipt Schema
description: Cryptographically signed receipt issued directly by the task beneficiary upon successful execution of physical or software work (AER Section 5: The Plumber Principle).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

task_id.description: Unique 32-byte identifier for the escrowed task or bilateral service contract.

worker_node_id.description: Ethereum address of the worker node delivering the solution.

beneficiary_node_id.description: Ethereum address of the client/beneficiary node confirming satisfaction.

solution_hash.description: SHA-256 digest H(Output) of the execution artifact, log, or physical telemetry.

execution_success.description: Strict boolean affirming non-defective completion according to client objective acceptance.

gas_or_fuel_used.description: WASM fuel or EVM gas consumed during verification.

energy_kwh.description: Physical energy discharged in kWh for physical/robotics tasks.

settlement_amount_credit_b.description: Amount of Credit B to be released from escrow in atomic units (1 Credit B = 1e18 units).

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds when the beneficiary signed the receipt.

nonce.description: Replay prevention nonce matching the task escrow contract state.

beneficiary_ecdsa_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA signature (r, s, v) generated by the beneficiary over the keccak256 hash of the receipt payload.
